##### Project general facts

Gardenia Residency is a prestigious residential development by the Shaikhani Group of Companies, a multi-billion dollar international business conglomerate with over thirty years of experience in real estate development. Offering a balanced mix of studios and one and two-bedroom apartments, as well as chic loft-style apartments and exclusive townhouses, this development is designed to deliver an "Escape from the Ordinary." With its stuccoed walls, tiled roofs, rustic arches, expansive balconies, and thematic wall designs, Gardenia Residency combines metropolitan sophistication with the rustic charm of the alluring Mediterranean.

Residents enjoy an unmatched array of distinctive amenities and features designed to elevate everyday living. Rooftop luxuries include a swimming pool, spa, sauna, jacuzzi, juice bar, and gym. The majestic marble lobby, private gardens and terraces, dedicated covered parking, retail arcade, lifestyle boutiques and cafes, round-the-clock security, incandescent lighting, and spellbinding landscaping complete the offering. A party hall and spa provide additional spaces for celebration and indulgence, while the rooftop health clubs and pool offer breathtaking views and relaxation.

Every residence at Gardenia Residency is immaculately designed, offering the utmost in comfort and luxury. The charming facade is matched by an equally striking interior, with every detail from the windows to the floors to striking furnishings leaving residents captivated. Signature suites feature flat-screen TVs with DVD/CD, state-of-the-art entertainment networks, fully equipped kitchens with dishwashers and refrigerators, and separate living rooms. Housekeeping services are provided daily for short-term stays and thrice weekly for longer stays, with access to the health club, spa and pool.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village, one of Dubai's most desirable districts, this exceptional location offers a complete sense of community with its international schools, shopping centres, restaurants, and mosques. The community is strategically located between Emirates Road, Al Khail Road, and Al Barsha Road, providing excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to key destinations. The World Expo 2020 site and Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport, are both within easy reach, ensuring significant investment potential and lucrative rental income. The master developer Nakheel has created a legacy built on leadership and pioneering innovation, providing residents with a perfect infrastructure setup that forms the foundation of this opulent community.

For those seeking a residence that embodies sumptuous living, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of luscious landscaping, impressive architecture, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can escape from the ordinary.
